title: Entering the Mortal World
summary: A cultivator chases Wang Lin out of the Country of Zhao and crushes his Nascent Soul with divine sense alone; he is Na Duo, an early Soul Transformation cultivator from Planet Five Elements, and he only wants back the storage bag he hid in the Land of the Ancient God. Impressed by Wang Lin's Extreme Realm and his half-finished restriction flag, Na Duo explains that a Cultivation Star Crystal, the national treasure of a level-6 cultivation country, can break the Extreme Realm bottleneck, and invites Wang Lin to find him one day. To reach Soul Formation Wang Lin decides he must live as a mortal, and travels with a medicine basket into a prosperous level-4 cultivation country, where he cures a poisoned noble girl with a willow leaf for her steward Lu Xing. Lu Xing explains the Four Faction Alliance of Baiyun Sect, Shuimo Sect, Qingmu Cliff and Heihun Sect that protects the capital of Nan. Wang Lin finds his killing energy has condensed to its limit, breaks through to mid Nascent Soul, meets a lecherous old man who sees through his hidden cultivation and tells him he needs an Intent Realm, and rents an empty shop on an old street.
